collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Shivering slightly on a cool night, a weaver wonders what people might wear in a land where the cold never leaves.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Shivering slightly on a cool night, (name1), a weaver, wonders what people might wear in a land where the cold never leaves.

choices.label: Ask Whether the Cold Is Real.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The weaver imagines layers of fur and fiber so thick a person looks like a walking haystack; the children act it out.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A healer wonders whether such clothing would be heavy and tiring, and how anyone would swim in it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A dyer guesses that people in a gray, cold place might love bright colors even more than Isolans do.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A skeptic says they might prefer plain colors, and the dyer admits there is no way to know.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A child refuses to believe anywhere could be cold all the time; an elder says they might be right.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A navigator mentions sailors' stories of cold winds, while admitting stories grow in the telling.
